name: Counter-Strike 2
description: Tactical rounds where careful aim, team communication and a single life matter.
costNote: In-game purchases; Prime Status is a paid upgrade.

name: Dota 2
description: Deep five-on-five strategy with a large hero roster and matches that need your attention.
costNote: All heroes are free; cosmetics and an optional subscription are sold separately.

name: Team Fortress 2
description: Class-based team shooting with distinct roles, playful maps and plenty of chaos.
costNote: In-game purchases; free accounts have some communication and trading restrictions.

name: Overwatch
description: Hero-based team battles built around combining abilities and switching roles.
costNote: In-game purchases; some additional content is sold separately.

name: Hearthstone
description: Turn-based card duels for when you want to plan combinations rather than test your reflexes.
costNote: Cards can be earned through play; card packs and other in-game purchases are available.

name: Diablo Immortal
description: Action-RPG dungeon runs, loot hunting and co-op encounters in the Diablo world.
costNote: Includes purchases that affect character progression, not just cosmetics.

name: Fortnite
description: Battle royale with friends, or explore and create player-made experiences.
costNote: In-game purchases; Save the World is a separate paid experience.

name: Rocket League
description: Car football with short matches and a high skill ceiling for aerial shots and teamwork.
costNote: Cosmetics and passes are sold separately. New PC players get it through Epic.

name: Fall Guys
description: Obstacle-course party rounds, with a course builder for making your own challenges.
costNote: Cosmetics and passes are sold separately.

name: League of Legends
description: Five-on-five lane battles where team roles, map awareness and practice pay off.
costNote: Champions can be earned or purchased; cosmetics are also sold.

name: VALORANT
description: Tactical team shooting that combines precise gunplay with agent abilities.
costNote: Agents can be earned or purchased; cosmetics are also sold. Requires Riot Vanguard.

name: Teamfight Tactics
description: Draft a team, arrange your board and adapt your strategy while the battles play out automatically.
costNote: Cosmetics and passes are sold separately. On PC, it uses the League of Legends client.
